ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Masini Taimi: Liliu ki tua pe ki muamua Aso ʻi he saileta ke vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala/vaxina ki muamua pe kahaʻu, fakahoa ʻa e hisitōlia, pea siviʻi ʻa e ngaahi tūkunga. Vakai pē; ʻoku ʻikai ala ki he fakamatala tupuʻanga.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN tefito: manako ange ki he fakamatala moʻoni, vakaiʻi ʻa e tafe ʻo e fakahū & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + jitter ʻi he k, p; ʻi he ngaahi ava 16 / 116 / 132 pe siteki 1072 ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻa e k*116 + p*16 ʻi he k, p ke hoa mo e fakahū, fakafonu ʻa e ngaahi ava ki muamua kapau ʻoku mole.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Foki ki he tā 119 (k*119 + jitter); ʻoka ava ko e 16 / 116 / 132 pe aʻu ki he siteki 1072 (founga laka 14), ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻa e k*116 + p*16 ʻi he k, p ke hiki ki he Fakahū A (A4 / A3) ʻoku feʻungamālie.
ui.tz_rule_last: Fakatahataha ʻi he tā 119 (k*119 + jitter); ʻi he ngaahi ava 16 / 116 / 132 pe siteki 1072 (k*116 + p*16 ʻi he k, p), manako ki he fakahū kuo fakatonutonu A2 / C7 pea foki ki he hala kapau ʻoku mole ʻa e fakamatala.
